checks.name: Valid draft cancellation and reopening
checks.expected: UI-1: Cancel discards provisional edits; reopen uses saved value
checks.actual: Draft 3 cancelled from saved 1. Visible summary and independent GET stayed 1 / 12; reopen showed 1.

checks.name: Save total, acknowledgement, and persistence
checks.expected: UI-1, UI-2, CART-4: Save updates and acknowledges cart with correct total
checks.actual: Keyboard Save 3 showed quantity 3, total 36, Cart updated. GET and reload confirmed persisted values.

checks.name: Narrow keyboard flow and invalid-draft recovery
checks.expected: UI-2: primary flow usable by keyboard at narrow and desktop widths, with visible errors
checks.actual: At 375×812, Tab/Enter opened editor, invalid 6 produced visible max-5 validation, keyboard Cancel discarded it, and keyboard Save restored 1.

checks.name: Invalid quantity types rejected without mutation
checks.expected: CART-2: negative, fractional, missing, null, string, boolean rejected with 400
checks.actual: PUT values -1, 1.5, null, string 2, true, and missing quantity each returned 400; a GET after every attempt stayed 3 / 36.

checks.name: Overstock rejected without mutation
checks.expected: CART-3: more than five returns 409 without mutation
checks.actual: Direct PUT quantity 6 returned 409; subsequent GET stayed 3 / 36.

checks.name: Alice update leaves Bob fixture unchanged
checks.expected: CART-1: caller changes only own cart
checks.actual: Alice saved 3; independent Bob GET remained initial 2 / 24.

checks.name: Cancel sends no update request
checks.expected: UI-1: Cancel sends no update request
checks.actual: Persisted-state preservation verified, but browser request capture was not available; no no-request claim is made.

checks.name: Fixture restoration
checks.actual: Final GETs confirm Alice 1 / 12 and Bob 2 / 24.

risks.reason: State remained unchanged but browser request methods/counts were not captured.
risks.next_probe: Capture network before valid and invalid Cancel and assert zero PUT requests.

risks.reason: UI overstock was stopped by native validation; direct API 409 did not exercise UI handling of a server failure.
risks.next_probe: Use controlled server rejection or delayed response and verify visible feedback, preserved draft, and successful retry.

risks.area: Removal and identity switching while editing
risks.reason: Zero removal was avoided because adding removed items is out of scope; UI identity switching with an open draft was not sampled.
risks.next_probe: Use a resettable fixture to test zero removal, then switch Alice/Bob during a draft and verify isolation.

observations.action: after narrow invalid Save then Cancel

limitations: Runtime-only: source was explicitly unavailable; source revision and deployed build are unknown.
Browser-generated API traffic and console errors were not captured; exact combined API request count is unknown. 23 direct requests and 27 state-changing browser actions were counted.
Only Chrome desktop and a 375×812 viewport sampled; exact browser version and desktop CSS dimensions not recorded. No real mobile device or screen-reader testing.
No zero removal, upper-valid-bound 5, concurrent tabs, rapid double Save, failure injection, or open-editor identity-switch test.
No claim of exhaustive authorization or accessibility coverage; sample is a disposable implementation, not production authentication.
cleanup: Restored Alice to quantity 1 via UI Save; independent GET confirmed Alice 1 / 12 and Bob unchanged 2 / 24. Reset viewport and closed own tab. No mocks or application changes.
